project_name: OnNowTV - Sports Replays Feature & Global Design Guidelines
design_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Minimalism & High Contrast)
context: Native Android TV & Web/Mobile Sports Streaming App - Replays Hub

replays_button.label: REPLAYS
replays_button.position: Top Navigation Menu alongside Live TV / Sports / Schedule
replays_button.style: px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-white/10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:bg-white/15

grid_layout.desktop_tv: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-5 p-6
grid_layout.performance_budget: Android Canvas / Native Drawables & lightweight CSS. Zero heavy WebGL or unoptimized blur filters for low-end boxes.

rules: Consistent square/rectangle dimensions across all 18 categories
Neutral high-quality generic sport background imagery (no misrepresenting single team as entire sport)
Dark contrast gradient overlay ensuring 4.5:1 APCA readability for title and subtext
1px subtle perimeter border with sharp 8px rounded corners
High visibility D-Pad focus frame (2px cyan/amber outline + scale-105 transition) for TV navigation
tile_design.hover_focus_state: transform scale-105 border-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)] duration-200 z-10

replay_matches_view.list_card_layout: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 hover:border-cyan-500/50 rounded-xl p-4 transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer
replay_matches_view.playback_behavior: Clicking any replay tile triggers immediate native recording playback (direct video player launch with back button control).

prominent_loading_band.description: Large visible animated progress bar + status description spanning top section of screen during recording verification and match index fetch.
prominent_loading_band.container_style: w-full bg-slate-900 border-b border-cyan-500/30 p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2
prominent_loading_band.progress_bar: w-full max-w-xl h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative

loading_and_feedback_states.partial_loading: Progressive rendering showing available categories immediately while background streams fetch remaining recordings.

empty_state.title: No Replays Currently Available
empty_state.subtitle: Check back shortly after live broadcast completes or select another sport category.

accessibility_and_testing.rule: Every interactive element must include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'REPLAYS' is prominently placed in the top menu header.
Render the 18 sport categories in a clean responsive grid of high-contrast tiles with atmospheric artwork backgrounds.
Ensure all 18 categories maintain visual parity while featuring sport-appropriate background photography.
Include a prominent loading band at the top during replay verification.
On category selection, list all channel recordings with date, team, programme, and channel details.
Clicking a match automatically launches replay stream with back navigation.
Maintain high performance for Android TV D-pad and portrait phone displays using native Canvas/CSS rendering.
